name: Thornwood side-view roguelike kit
blurb: Everything for a side-view action roguelike in a forest and a stone keep: a runner who strikes, shoots a bow and dodges, seven kinds of enemy with an archer and an elite champion, two bosses, forest, cave and castle ground, gates between areas, a scroll stand and boon icons, weapons to pick up, loot beams, a run HUD, 34 sounds and five tracks.
